item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 1 #SLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 11:00 PM 17 August 2026

Yellow Warning: #OrientalMindoro
Associated Hazard: FLOODING in low lying areas and near river channels.

Meanwhile, Moderate to heavy rains are expected over #Romblon(Cajidiocan, Magdiwang, SanFernando), #Marinduque(Boac, Gasan and Buenavista) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Romblon(Alcantara, Banton, Calatrava, Concepcion, Corcuera, Looc, Odiongan, Romblon, SanAgustin, SanAndres, SanJose, SantaFe, Ferrol and SantaMaria) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 02:00 AM Tomorrow.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
Issued at 10:45 PM 17 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #Masbate(PioV.Corpuz, Cataingan, Placer, Esperanza, Batuan, SanFernando), #NorthernSamar(Lapinig, Gamay, Mapanas and Catubig) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
